learn.hook: Wave your hand in the sun. A dark hand waves back on the ground! That is your shadow.
points: A shadow forms when something blocks light.
People, trees and animals all make shadows in sunlight.
No light means no shadow. In a dark room, shadows vanish.
Bring a torch closer to a toy and its shadow grows bigger.
Our shadow is long in the early morning and evening, and shortest at noon.

example.q: Ravi stands in the sun at 7 in the morning and again at 12 noon. When is his shadow longer?
steps: In the early morning the sun is low in the sky.
A low sun makes a long shadow. At noon the sun is high, so the shadow is short.

learn.reallife: On a hot afternoon, cows rest in the shade of a big tree.

games.title: True or false?
items: A shadow forms when light is blocked
The object stops the light, so a dark shape forms behind it.
We can see our shadow in a fully dark room
Without light there is no shadow.
Our shadow is shortest at noon
At noon the sun is high above us.
Moving a torch closer to a toy makes its shadow smaller
A closer torch makes a bigger shadow.
A tree makes a shadow on a sunny day

quiz.q: When does a shadow form?
quiz.explain: An object stops the light. The dark patch behind it is the shadow.
quiz.mistake: Thinks shadows come from darkness, not from light

quiz.q: Mona switches off every light in her room at night. What happens to her shadow?
quiz.explain: A shadow needs light. With no light, there is no shadow.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a shadow is always there

quiz.q: Abu moves a torch closer to his toy elephant. What happens to its shadow on the wall?
quiz.explain: When the torch comes closer, the toy blocks more light, so the shadow grows.
quiz.mistake: Thinks closer light makes a smaller shadow

quiz.q: At what time of day is your shadow the shortest?
quiz.explain: At noon the sun is high overhead, so the shadow is short.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up morning and noon shadows

quiz.q: Which of these makes a shadow in the sun?
quiz.explain: A tree is a thing that blocks sunlight, so it makes a shadow.
quiz.mistake: Does not know only objects can block light

quiz.q: Rani sees that her shadow is very long. What time is it most likely?
quiz.explain: Shadows are long when the sun is low, in the early morning or evening.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the shadow is longest at noon

teach.ask: Gappu: Why do I see my shadow on a sunny day?
teach.praise: Yes! You block the sunlight, so a shadow forms.
teach.nudge: What does my body do to the sunlight?

topics.title: Flat shapes from shadows and tracing

learn.hook: Put a can on paper and draw around it. Surprise! A flat shape appears.
points: A shadow is flat. It shows a flat shape.
Draw around the face of a solid shape to get a flat shape.
The bottom of a can or a glass gives a circle.
A face of a dice gives a square. The long face of a brick gives a rectangle.
A party cap seen from the side makes a triangle shadow.

example.q: Harpreet puts a matchbox on paper on its big face and draws around it. What shape does she get?
steps: The big face of a matchbox is long and flat.
It has 4 straight sides and 4 corners.
Two sides are long and two are short.

learn.reallife: At night, make hand shadows on the wall with a torch. Shadows are flat pictures.

games.title: What shape will you get?
pairs: Side shadow of a party cap

games.title: True or false?
items: A shadow lies flat on the wall or the floor.
Drawing around a face of a dice gives a square.
Every face of a dice is a square.
A ball has a flat face we can draw around.
A ball is curved all over. It has no flat face.
Drawing around the bottom of a glass gives a triangle.
The bottom of a glass is round, so we get a circle.

quiz.q: Riya draws around the bottom of a juice can. What shape does she get?
quiz.explain: The bottom of a can is round. Drawing around it gives a circle.
quiz.mistake: Thinks of the side of the can, not its bottom

quiz.q: Arjun draws around one face of a dice. What shape does he get?
quiz.explain: Every face of a dice has 4 equal sides. That is a square.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up the solid cube with its flat face

quiz.q: Meena draws around the long face of a brick. What shape does she get?
quiz.explain: The long face has 2 long sides and 2 short sides. That is a rectangle.
quiz.mistake: Calls every 4-sided shape a square

quiz.q: Kabir shines a torch on a ball. What shape is its shadow on the wall?
quiz.explain: A ball is round, so its shadow is a round circle.
quiz.mistake: Guesses without thinking of the ball's round shape

quiz.q: Which solid shape can make a triangle shadow from the side?
quiz.explain: A party cap is a cone. From the side it has a pointed top and a flat bottom, like a triangle.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a dice can make a triangle

quiz.q: Which thing has a face you can draw around to get a square?
quiz.explain: A dice is a cube. Each of its faces is a square.
quiz.mistake: Picks a round object that gives a circle

teach.ask: Gappu: I drew around the bottom of a can. Why did I get a circle?
teach.praise: Yes! The flat bottom of a can is round, so it makes a circle.
teach.nudge: What shape is the flat bottom of the can?

learn.hook: A bangle, a roti and a samosa! Which ones are circles?
points: A circle is round. It has no straight sides and no corners.
A triangle has 3 straight sides.
A triangle has 3 corners.
A bangle and a coin look like circles. A samosa looks like a triangle.

example.q: How many sides and corners do 2 triangles have in all?

learn.reallife: A roti and a wheel are round like circles. A slice of pizza looks like a triangle.

quiz.q: How many sides does a triangle have?
quiz.explain: Tri means three. A triangle has 3 straight sides.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up a triangle with a square

quiz.q: How many corners does a circle have?
quiz.explain: A circle is round all the way. It has no corners at all.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the start of the drawing is a corner

quiz.q: A samosa lying flat on a plate looks like a ___.
quiz.explain: A samosa has 3 pointy corners and 3 sides, like a triangle.
quiz.mistake: Does not count the corners

quiz.q: Which of these looks like a circle?
quiz.explain: A bangle is round with no corners, like a circle.
quiz.mistake: Picks a shape that has corners

quiz.q: Aisha drew a shape with 3 straight sides. What did she draw?
quiz.explain: A shape with 3 straight sides is a triangle.
quiz.mistake: Thinks any shape with straight sides is a square

quiz.q: How many corners do 2 triangles have in all?
quiz.explain: Each triangle has 3 corners. 3 + 3 = 6.
quiz.mistake: Counts the corners of only one triangle

teach.ask: Gappu: How can I tell a circle from a triangle?
teach.praise: Super! A circle is round with no corners. A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners.
teach.nudge: How many sides does a triangle have? Does a circle have corners?

learn.hook: A carrom board and a classroom door both have 4 sides. But they look different!
points: A square has 4 sides. All 4 sides are the same length.
A square has 4 corners.
A rectangle has 4 sides and 4 corners too.
In a rectangle, sides facing each other are the same. A door has 2 long and 2 short sides.

example.q: Kabir counts the corners on 1 square and 1 triangle. How many corners in all?

learn.reallife: A carrom board is a square. A door, a blackboard and a train ticket are rectangles.

quiz.q: How many sides does a square have?
quiz.explain: A square has 4 straight sides, all the same length.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up a square with a triangle

quiz.q: What is special about the 4 sides of a square?
options: They are all the same length
quiz.explain: All 4 sides of a square are equal. That is what makes it a square.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up a square with a rectangle like a door

quiz.q: A classroom door looks like a ___.
quiz.explain: A door has 4 sides: 2 long and 2 short. That is a rectangle.
quiz.mistake: Calls every 4-sided shape a square

quiz.q: How many corners does a rectangle have?
quiz.explain: A rectangle has 4 corners, one at each end of its sides.
quiz.mistake: Counts only the corners on one side

quiz.q: Joseph plays carrom. The carrom board looks like a ___.
quiz.explain: A carrom board has 4 equal sides and 4 corners. It is a square.
quiz.mistake: Thinks of the round carrom pieces instead of the board

quiz.q: How many corners do 1 square and 1 triangle have in all?
quiz.explain: A square has 4 corners and a triangle has 3. 4 + 3 = 7.
quiz.mistake: Thinks both shapes have 4 corners

teach.ask: Gappu: A square and a rectangle both have 4 sides. How are they different?
teach.praise: Now I know! A square has 4 equal sides. A rectangle has 2 long and 2 short sides.
teach.nudge: Are all the sides the same length in both? Which one has long and short sides?

topics.title: Shapes in designs and wall hangings

learn.hook: Look at a rangoli or a kite. It is full of circles, squares and triangles!
points: Designs and patterns are made of flat shapes.
Look carefully and count each kind of shape.
Colour each kind of shape with its own colour. Then counting is easy.
Cut out paper shapes and stick them on a string to make a wall hanging.

example.q: A kite design has 4 triangles, 1 square and 2 circles. How many shapes in all?

learn.reallife: Rangoli, kites and toran wall hangings use many shapes.

quiz.q: A rangoli has 3 circles, 4 triangles and 2 squares. How many triangles?
quiz.explain: The rangoli has 4 triangles. 3 are circles and 2 are squares.
quiz.mistake: Counts the wrong shape

quiz.q: A rangoli has 3 circles, 4 triangles and 2 squares. How many shapes in all?
quiz.mistake: Leaves out one kind of shape

quiz.q: Tia colours every triangle red and every circle blue in her design. Why does this help?
options: She can count each shape easily
quiz.explain: Each colour shows one kind of shape, so she can count them quickly.
quiz.mistake: Thinks colour changes the shape

quiz.q: Kunal makes a wall hanging with 5 paper triangles and 3 paper circles. How many cut-outs did he use?
quiz.explain: 5 + 3 = 8 cut-outs.
quiz.mistake: Takes away instead of adding

quiz.q: Which shape has 4 sides, two long and two short?
quiz.explain: A rectangle has 4 sides. Opposite sides match: 2 long and 2 short.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a square has long and short sides

quiz.q: A design has 6 squares. Rina colours 2 of them yellow. How many squares are not yellow?
quiz.explain: 6 - 2 = 4 squares are not yellow.
quiz.mistake: Adds instead of taking away

quiz.q: Priya makes her own design with 2 circles, 3 triangles and 1 square. How many different kinds of shapes did she use?
quiz.explain: The kinds are circle, triangle and square. That is 3 kinds, even though there are 6 shapes.
quiz.mistake: Counts all the shapes instead of the kinds of shapes

teach.ask: Gappu: How do I count the shapes in a rangoli?
teach.praise: Yes! Find each kind of shape and count it. Colours help!
teach.nudge: Which shapes can I see? How do I keep track while counting?

topics.title: Corners, straight edges and curved edges

learn.hook: Four friends stand at the four corners of a table. What is a corner?
points: A corner is where two straight edges meet.
A rectangle table top has 4 corners.
Round things like a plate or a bangle have curved edges and 0 corners.
Some things have both straight and curved edges, like a gas cylinder.

example.q: 4 children stand at the corners of a table. 4 more stand between them, one on each side. How many children?

learn.reallife: Table corners can be sharp. A round table has no corners at all!

games.title: True or false?
items: A corner is where two straight edges meet
Two straight edges meet at a point.
A plate has a curved edge and no corners.
A rectangle table top has 4 corners
It has 4 straight edges that meet at 4 corners.
A bangle is round with a curved edge.
A gas cylinder has only curved edges
Its sides are straight, and its top and bottom edges are curved.

quiz.q: Where is a corner formed?
options: In the middle of a side
quiz.explain: A corner is the point where two straight edges meet.
quiz.mistake: Thinks any point on an edge is a corner

quiz.q: How many corners does a rectangle table top have?
quiz.explain: A rectangle has 4 straight edges and 4 corners.
quiz.mistake: Counts only the corners near them

quiz.q: How many corners does a round roti have?
quiz.explain: A roti is round. Its edge is curved, so it has no corners.
quiz.mistake: Thinks every shape has corners

quiz.q: Which object has only a curved edge?
quiz.explain: A coin is round. The others have straight edges.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up curved and straight edges

quiz.q: Which object has both straight and curved edges?
quiz.explain: A gas cylinder has straight sides and curved edges at the top and bottom.
quiz.mistake: Thinks an object has only one kind of edge

quiz.q: One child stands at each corner of 2 square mats. How many children?
quiz.explain: Each square has 4 corners. 4 + 4 = 8 children.
quiz.mistake: Counts the corners of only one mat

teach.ask: Gappu: Does a plate have corners? Does a table?
teach.praise: Right! Corners come where straight edges meet. A round plate has none.
teach.nudge: Where do corners come from? Is a plate straight or curved?

learn.hook: Take a paper, fold it, and turn it into a square, a triangle ... and a dog!
points: Fold one corner of a rectangle paper to the other side and cut off the extra strip. Open it: a square!
A square has 4 corners and 4 edges.
Fold a square from corner to corner to get a triangle.
A triangle has 3 corners and 3 edges.
Fold the side corners of the triangle down to make a dog's ears!

example.q: Fold a square from corner to corner. What shape do you get, and how many corners?
steps: One corner meets the opposite corner.
The folded paper is a triangle.

learn.reallife: Origami is the art of folding paper into toys, birds and animals.

games.title: Make a paper dog
games.prompt: Steps for a paper dog face
items: Fold it corner to corner into a triangle
Fold the two side corners down as ears

games.title: Fold and match
pairs: Fold a square corner to corner
Fold a square edge to edge

quiz.q: How many corners does a square sheet of paper have?
quiz.explain: A square has 4 corners.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up a square and a triangle

quiz.q: Tina folds a square paper from corner to corner. What shape does she get?
quiz.explain: Folding corner to corner makes a triangle.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the fold gives a rectangle

quiz.q: How many edges does the folded paper triangle have?
quiz.explain: A triangle has 3 edges and 3 corners.
quiz.mistake: Counts the square's edges

quiz.q: Fold a square corner to corner both ways, then open it. How many small triangles do you see?
quiz.explain: The two folds cross in the middle and make 4 small triangles.
quiz.mistake: Counts only one fold

quiz.q: Meena makes 3 paper triangles. How many corners in all?
quiz.explain: Each triangle has 3 corners. 3 + 3 + 3 = 9.
quiz.mistake: Counts the triangles, not the corners

quiz.q: To make a paper dog face, what do we fold first?
quiz.explain: We fold a square into a triangle, then fold its corners down as ears.
quiz.mistake: Does not remember the first fold

teach.ask: Gappu: How do I turn a square paper into a triangle?
teach.praise: Yes! Fold it from one corner to the opposite corner.
teach.nudge: Which part of the square should meet when I fold?

learn.hook: Dip a bottle cap in paint and press it on paper. Again and again. You made a pattern!
points: Press painted things like bottle caps or erasers on paper to make prints.
A bottle cap prints a circle. An eraser prints a rectangle.
Trace your hand and decorate it like mehndi.
Paint a leaf and press it to make a leaf print.
A pattern repeats shapes or colours in the same order.

example.q: Rohan stamps: circle, rectangle, circle, rectangle, circle. What comes next?
steps: The order is circle, rectangle, again and again.
After a circle comes a rectangle.

learn.reallife: Block-printed sarees and bedsheets repeat the same stamp to make patterns.

quiz.q: What shape does a round bottle cap print?
quiz.explain: The rim of the cap is round, so it prints a circle.
quiz.mistake: Does not link the object to its flat face

quiz.q: Gita dips an eraser in paint and stamps it. What shape does she see?
quiz.explain: An eraser has a rectangle face, so it prints a rectangle.
quiz.mistake: Thinks every print is round

quiz.q: In the stamp pattern ○ □ ○ □ ○ ___, what comes next?
quiz.explain: Circle and square take turns. After a circle comes a square.
quiz.mistake: Repeats the last shape

quiz.q: Which of these is a pattern?
options: red, green, red, green, red, green
quiz.explain: Red, green repeats in the same order every time.
quiz.mistake: Thinks any mix of colours is a pattern

quiz.q: Sara prints a pattern: 🍃🍃✋🍃🍃✋. How many leaves are there?
quiz.explain: Each part has 2 leaves and 1 hand. 2 parts have 2 + 2 = 4 leaves.
quiz.mistake: Counts the hands too

quiz.q: A mehndi pattern goes: dot, leaf, dot, leaf. What is the 5th design?
quiz.explain: 1st dot, 2nd leaf, 3rd dot, 4th leaf, 5th dot.
quiz.mistake: Loses count of the position

teach.ask: Gappu: What makes something a pattern?
teach.praise: Yes! A pattern repeats the same things in the same order.
teach.nudge: Do the shapes come again? Is the order the same?

learn.hook: Hop on tiles: 1, 4, 7, 10 ... The frog adds 3 each time!
points: To extend a shape pattern, find the part that repeats.
Jumps on tiles make number patterns: 1, 4, 7, 10 adds 3.
1, 7, 13 adds 6. Find the jump, then add it again to get the next number.
learn.reallife: Dates of the same weekday on a calendar, like 7, 14, 21, 28, add 7 each time.

quiz.q: A frog jumps on tiles: 1, 4, 7, 10. Which tile does it land on next?
quiz.explain: It adds 3 each time. 10 + 3 = 13.
quiz.mistake: Adds 1 instead of 3

quiz.q: What is the rule in 1, 6, 11, 16?
quiz.mistake: Uses the second number as the rule

quiz.q: Extend the pattern: 7, 14, 21, ___
quiz.explain: It adds 7 each time. 21 + 7 = 28.
quiz.mistake: Adds 1 instead of 7

quiz.q: Extend the pattern: 1, 7, 13, ___
quiz.explain: It adds 6 each time. 13 + 6 = 19.
quiz.mistake: Adds 7 or 1 instead of 6

quiz.q: In the tile pattern △ ○ ○ △ ○ ○ △ ___, what comes next?
quiz.explain: The part that repeats is △ ○ ○. After △ comes ○.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the shapes just take turns

quiz.q: Asha writes 3, 8, 13, 18. What does she write next?
quiz.explain: The rule is add 5. 18 + 5 = 23.
quiz.mistake: Adds 1 to the last number

teach.ask: Gappu: How do I find the next number in 1, 6, 11?
teach.praise: Yes! It adds 5 each time, so next is 16.
teach.nudge: How much does it jump each time?
